enchantments.tooltip: Sticky Goo Guard: This item has a chance of encasing a creature in sticky goo, much like an attack of a mimic. It reduces the creatures move speed and attack speed.
Deathblock: The wearer of this item is immune to all death spells and magical death effects.
Fortification +97%: +97% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Physical Sheltering +20: +20 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Damage Reduction 10/Lawful: Reduces physical damage by 10, except from Lawful attacks.
